study.question: Does bounded within-slot value transport need the current target, or can a history-only prototype preserve useful evidence? Does differentiating through the transport scores explain the gain? Evaluate this conditional on the incumbent unified field/feedback/age readouts, with matched learned capacity and measured cost.
study.hypothesis: Observed: aligned/reversed/rotated transport click AUCs0.66429336/0.66431928/0.66424931 all exceed execution-matched null0.66381970; these are single-seed validation observations, with diagnostics not_requested. Reversal and coordinate rotation retain target information and do not establish a target-free mechanism. Earlier learned target/history routers (0.65983966/0.66005224) both fell below their0.66064694 parent; they are unsuccessful implementations, not a general refutation. Hypothesis: slot-local directional agreement can retain useful within-slot value variation without conditioning the transport on the target; learning through the scores may contribute independently. A2x2 replacement of transport query (target versus history centroid) and score derivative (live versus stopped) separates these two explanations. Only the transport loses target conditioning; downstream target-conditioned scorer/correction/readouts remain inherited.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text arXiv1706.06978v4, local activation and unnormalized attention; inherited DIN-style scorer is retained over30 compressed slots. The intervention is a parameter-free count-preserving covariance tilt inside each slot, and tests a history-only query and score-gradient ownership rather than asserting target attention is new. No exact DIN reproduction or priority claim. Primary mechanism inspected at archived lines250-277 and Dice at317-336; no cross-dataset numerical claim imported.

Pinned90bb99a implementation forward lines113-144 pools history with target attention then tokenizes fields/tasks and applies interaction blocks. We do not import these blocks; keep incumbent downstream state and alter only within-slot value selection before inherited readouts. This is a difference from benchmark code, not proof of difference from every original-paper method.

Archived section2.3 distinguishes target pooling from per-layer query/history interaction (HiFormer, HyFormer, MixFormer). Current experiment is a narrower replacement/gradient factorial inside an existing compressor, not a reproduction of these architectures. paper:hiformer has no authorized detailed text; global originality remains unverified.

Own-arm prior learned rank16 router used history queries and bounded-softmax mixing before recent/age/identity/angular refinements; it underperformed its parent and incurred extra capacity. Current prototype is the equal-event per-field directional mean of each exact existing slot, adds no modules, and explicitly factors score derivatives. Prior target/history router results cannot be pooled as matched current controls.

study.proposed_difference: Replace only the transport helper and its configuration. Let u_if be each valid event field normalized with eps1e-8. In each exact slot j, form m_jf=mean_i(u_if). The history query is normalize(m_jf,eps1e-8); the target query is normalize(target_f,eps1e-8). Score s_ji=clip(mean_f(dot(q_jf,u_if)),-1,1), masked to slot membership. Compute C_j=mean(s*v)-mean(s)*mean(v), set C=0 for n<=1, and pass original_value_mean+0.5*C only into _pool. Two cells detach s before the cross-moment; value gradients remain. In exact arithmetic this is mean of v weighted by1+0.5*(s-mean(s)), weights in[0,2] and sum n. All cells compute both query sources and use identical FP32 BMM shapes; no transport reversal/sort or duplicate cross-moment is needed. Existing chronological compressor permutation machinery stays inherited. No added trainable parameters; expected total32295406, embedding31793216, dense502190, to be host-measured. Target_live is a mathematical aligned-score anchor with a changed reduction kernel, requiring fixed-weight parity with the archived aligned source; no bitwise training or speedup promise.
predictions: Primary planned query contrast: centroid_live minus target_live validation click AUC; repeat the query contrast with stopped scores. Comparable or better centroid cells would support a target-free transport implementation conditional on this model, but cannot establish equivalence without intervals and repetition. A reproducible gain>=0.0003 would warrant follow-up, not establish significance.

Primary planned derivative contrasts: live minus stopped within each query; report interaction (centroid_live-centroid_stopped)-(target_live-target_stopped). If stopped matches live, score-gradient adaptation is unnecessary for this implementation; if live wins both queries, optimization may explain part of prior gains.

All cells have identical learned state shapes/initial values, total capacity and fixed-weight forward outputs within a query across live/stopped modes. Centroid transport is invariant to changing only the current target at fixed raw history; complete model predictions need not be invariant.
No covariance correction for empty/singleton slots; unchanged per-slot value mean when scores or values are homogeneous. Raw padded content/action and task-mask perturbations do not affect outputs.

A single score BMM plus one cross-moment BMM and no reversal map may reduce transport overhead relative to r0020, but new prototype BMM and selected backward graph have costs. Report measured training/inference/memory and all four task quality metrics; current model is not yet faster than baseline DIN.
falsifiers: If both history-query cells reliably lose to their same-gradient target-query controls, the target-free directional-prototype hypothesis is unsupported in this fixed model; do not treat other history-query designs as refuted.
If stopped scores retain all gains, reject the necessity of score derivatives; if only live history wins, prioritize the query-by-gradient interaction rather than pure information selection.

Failure of fixed-weight target_live parity with archived aligned_values beyond declared FP32/BF16 tolerances blocks scientific comparison until the implementation is corrected without changing the frozen protocol.

Any leakage from padding/current action, altered assignment/count/scorer state, nonfinite tensor/gradients, auxiliary access to forbidden gradient sources or different initialization invalidates the affected run before training.

No efficiency support if measured cost does not improve at comparable quality; no transport-benefit attribution without matched null follow-up if historical-kernel drift or score-scale confounds remain.
